   472→def compute_checksum(dimensions: dict) -> str:
   473→    """Compute deterministic checksum for profile. Delegates to usd_bridge canonical implementation."""
   474→    if HAS_USD_BRIDGE:
   475→        return _usd_compute_checksum(dimensions)
   476→    # Inline fallback when usd_bridge unavailable
   477→    sorted_dims = sorted(dimensions.items())
   478→    serialized = "TRL_v1|" + "|".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k, v in sorted_dims)
   479→    hash_val = 5381
   480→    for char in serialized:
   481→        hash_val = ((hash_val << 5) + hash_val) + ord(char)
   482→        hash_val &= 0xFFFFFFFF
   483→    return format(hash_val, '08x')
